question: bankai-handbooks HQ-B (CON-13 Port rulings): what does an ABSENT pair file mean, at tags from v0.11.0 and before?

options.label: Error from v0.11.0, none before (Recommended)
options.consequence: Absent at a tag >= v0.11.0 = a refusal naming the pair and tag; absent before v0.11.0 = no rulings

options.label: Always an error
options.consequence: Absent is a refusal at every tag; readers of older tags must upgrade
